mission: Unseeded release Market Value contract (owner t541u 2026-11-20 07:41 MYT, Sentry staging issue f62436bf19f143aaa04171123c8e68e4): GET /analytics/market-value, /movers and /most-valuable answer 404 with detail release_market_value_not_seeded (plus release_product_id, release_code, release_name) for a real release that has no persisted Market Value points, instead of 503 market_value_not_seeded. 503 stays for an unseeded Overall and for ranking integrity failures. The web page shows 'Market Value for <release> isn't published yet' on the hero, movers and most-valuable sections, with no retry button and no 'could not be loaded'. No database, collector or workflow change.

impacts.reason: Public API contract change (AMBER by owner t541u): a real release with no Market Value points returns 404 release_market_value_not_seeded with its identity instead of 503, identical on all three endpoints. Unseeded Overall and integrity failures stay 503. Read-only code path, no query added.
Web reads the 404 body and shows the not-published message on hero, movers and most-valuable, with no retry; other 404 and 5xx wording is unchanged.
API tests per endpoint for seeded Overall with an unseeded release, and for unseeded Overall staying 503; web test for the shared release URL and for unchanged unknown-release and 503 wording.
docs/market_value.md and docs/route_inventory.md state the new 404 contract.

impact.deployment_impact: API and Vercel staging web redeploy. No collector input changes, no RAW migration, no fleet change.

recovery.procedure: Native revert PR of this merge with its own mission file; the three endpoints return 503 market_value_not_seeded again and the web shows its previous wording.
recovery.trigger: Staging delivery verify fails, a seeded release or Overall stops returning 200, or new Sentry events appear for these routes after merge.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema or row change.

verification.observation_window: This merge's staging delivery verify, then the staging page for an unseeded release id and Sentry for the three routes.
